g.text: variant INCLUDING domestic poultry flock outbreaks (aphis_flocks; mostly Gallus gallus): 32,696 dated events. Poultry events rank 4th by count (2,250) and dominate panel d by birds affected (208.5M vs ~1.6M wild). Farm outbreaks are a systematically-reported surveillance stream — not directly comparable to wildlife mortality findings.
